verse.verse_1: The emulous desire of abundance engrosseth you,
verse.verse_4: Again lo! presently ye shall know.
verse.verse_5: Lo! would that ye knew now with the surety of knowledge!
verse.verse_7: Then ye shall surely beholdwith the surety of vision.
verse.verse_8: Then, on that Day, ye shall surely be asked of the delights.
